name: Poughkeepsie
title: Hudson River Paddling Conditions Near Poughkeepsie, NY
blurb: Waryas Park, under the Mid-Hudson Bridge and the Walkway Over the Hudson. Midway between the Highlands and Kingston, on a straight and comparatively narrow reach of river.

tide.label: NOAA 8518945 Poughkeepsie
tide.note: Tide from NOAA station 8518945 at Poughkeepsie, half a mile from the launch.
tide.cardNote: Unless you plan on landing on a beach or poking into a shallow creek, tide is likely not very important to you.

current.label: NOAA HUR0620_11 Mid-Hudson Bridge
current.note: Current from NOAA station HUR0620_11 (Mid-Hudson Suspension Bridge), half a mile from the launch. The shallowest bin published there is 16 ft.
